newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish fixed bond minimum prices rise at tender.
newsitem.headline: Polish fixed bond minimum prices rise at tender.

text.p: The minimum price of Poland's 15-percent two-year fixed bonds rose to 90.35 from 89.82 at the previous tender, the central bank said.
The minimum price of the 12-percent five-year bond rose to 79.59 from 79.29 at the last tender on April 2.
The finance ministry sold 797 million zlotys of the bonds at the 800 million tender after investors bid for 1.45 billion.
The ministry sold 542 million zlotys of the shorter bonds and 255 million zlotys of the longer paper.
